description: List weekly timesheets for native WEEKLY-review contracts: your own submissions (worker view, default) or — with role "buyer" — timesheets submitted on contracts you hire on. Provider-backed FINAL_ONLY contracts use one final contract statement instead and do not send weekly reminders. Requires time:read scope and the public API time-tracking feature.

role.description: Perspective: your own timesheets (worker, default) or timesheets awaiting you as the buyer.

name: opentrain_time_timesheets
